name: Still Heart
source:
Many speculate about what truly happened to Celine's older sister. Some say she died, others claim she's simply disappeared. A few superstitious folk say she was sacrificed to the devil. No one truly knows.

Well, one girl does. You follow the story of Rachel, a high school senior who eagerly awaits the end of the year, and a fresh chapter at college. She knows what happened to Mia, but she won't budge. It's your goal to find out what happened through context clues, clever dialogue options, and reading between the lines.

Or not. You don't have to, nobody's forcing you.

[From [url=https://briochebunny.itch.io/still-heart-demo]itch.io[/url]]
